label: Leaf miner gallery
notes: The leaf-miner hand inked as a mine: the gallery widens as the larva grows and swells smoothly into a round pupal chamber, a frass line running down it. The mass comes from the source, so the line becomes a bead with no snap. Ian, round 11: "these are super good keep". Controls: the miner's hand (any frozen hand; trail_miner is the source), how long the mine runs, how wide the grown larva is, the chamber, the frass and the seed. Fill stays `chamber`: `late` turns the mine into a solid bar, the capsule Ian dislikes (round 11's tile 3, kept out on purpose). The sheet's other tiles: seeds 7201-7203 with widths 4.0 / 5.0 mm and frass wander / none.

recipe.label: trail_miner as a mine: widens with age to 3.2 mm, frass line, fill chamber, chamber 2.2x (seed 7200)
